title: eMediBlock: a secure service-oriented framework for electronic health record management using blockchain
description: Smart contracts, benchmarks, eleven-attack suite and offline experiment code accompanying the eMediBlock manuscript. Includes epoch-fenced consent, accountable break-glass access, batched Merkle anchoring, consent-gated erasure-coded recovery, HL7 FHIR canonical-form integrity, and congestion-aware transaction scheduling.

creators.name: Singh, Sunil Kumar
